title: Security
intro: Protecting user information matters to SiteSynergy. This page describes the public website and how to report a security concern in clear terms.

sections.title: Scope
paragraphs: This information concerns the public website. Sign-in or platform features activated later may have separate controls and terms. We do not claim a compliance certification, independent penetration test, or features such as SSO without formal confirmation.

sections.title: Safe communication
paragraphs: Do not send passwords, access keys, or sensitive project details through the contact page or general email. Contact us first to arrange a suitable way to exchange sensitive information.

sections.title: Browser preferences
paragraphs: Your language choice is saved in browser local storage, and your response to the storage notice is recorded in a necessary cookie. The website does not use these choices for account sign-in or authentication.

sections.title: Report a vulnerability
paragraphs: If you find a security issue, email a description and reproduction steps to hello@sitesynergy.com. Please avoid accessing other people’s data or disrupting the service while we review the report.
